info.title: DevTrack shared API contracts
info.description: Generated from the current shared Zod schemas and explicitly registered backend routes. This is not a catalogue of every backend endpoint. Shared contracts currently cover common, focus, contests and revision. Auth/SSE describe existing runtime routes. Untyped response payloads stay unspecified. Zod transformations and cross-field refinements still require runtime validation.

servers.description: Current versioned API; only explicitly listed operations advertise v2.

get.description: The current controller returns an array. Only the platform filter is consumed; the exported pagination contract is not yet wired here.

post.description: Canonical shared request uses plannedSec. The controller also accepts a legacy plannedDurationMinutes field.
